title: Privacy & data (M13)
brief: Privacy & data screen of goop (/privacy, from Settings). goop is local-only: encrypted SQLite (key wrapped by TPM2 on Linux, DPAPI on Windows), no telemetry, secrets removed before any model sees text (DLP), tamper check on the database. Full screen with title breadcrumb and no key-hint line under the header. A calm trust summary line (green ● all local · encrypted · no telemetry · 0 bytes sent today). Two panes like M8: on the left What goop keeps, one line per store with size and age (Offers 412 · 18 MB · kept 90 days; Sessions 7 · 2.1 MB; Rules 7; Profile and CV · cv-2026.pdf; Search index 9 MB; Logs 1.2 MB · 14 days; Models 31 GB, not personal data), each personal store clearable on its own, Sessions selected; on the right the selection's details, the protection facts (Encryption AES-256 SQLCipher with the key sealed by TPM2, Integrity checked at start ok 09:00, Network only public job boards and model downloads, Secrets removed before a model sees text · 3 this month) and retention form rows (offers 90 days, logs 14 days). One status line with the privacy focus mode and ↑↓ move · x clear this · e export (encrypted .zip) · r retention · D delete all data · esc back; D leads to the M11 type-to-confirm dialog. Below the screen: the export toast, the one-line clear-sessions ask and the pink integrity-failed status line chip.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Trust summary plus a store list grouped as your data vs models and one details pane with protection facts and retention rows; every store, its size and what protects it are visible at once, but the details show one store at a time, the facts are static text that may be skimmed, and the screen hides the chat
